PRIVACY

A simple site, with clear boundaries.

Effective 2 November 2026. This notice describes the current static Deskwise Guide website.

What this website includes

The site has no visitor accounts, checkout, newsletter form, advertising scripts or analytics scripts. The guide filter runs in your browser and does not save your selection. Our own code does not set cookies or use browser storage.

Hosting and technical information

The website is published using OpenAI Sites and its Cloudflare-based hosting infrastructure. Hosting and security providers may process connection information such as IP address, request time, browser information and requested URL to deliver and protect the site. Deskwise does not specify a separate retention period for provider-controlled logs. Review OpenAI's privacy policy and Cloudflare's privacy policy for provider practices.

Amazon and other outbound links

Opening an external link takes you to another service with its own policies. Amazon shopping links currently contain no Associates tracking IDs. Amazon may process your visit under its own privacy and cookie practices. Deskwise does not receive your order, payment or account details from these ordinary links.

Contact through GitHub

Our contact route is the public GitHub project issue tracker. GitHub processes account information and posted content under its privacy statement. Public issues are visible to others. Avoid posting personal or sensitive information.

Questions and changes

For a general website privacy question, use the contact route without posting sensitive details. If analytics, forms, accounts or affiliate tools are added, this notice must be updated to describe the resulting practices. The effective date above will change when the notice is revised.
